metadata.diff:
Index: /home/agent/workspace/checker.py
===================================================================
--- /home/agent/workspace/checker.py
+++ /home/agent/workspace/checker.py
@@ -327,8 +327,12 @@
     continue
 got = norm(steps[fid]['text'])
 want = norm(stmts.get(n, ''))
 if got == want:
+    if getattr(norm, 'definedness_stripped', False):
+        note(f"OBL-{n}: 'defined(nth(M,i))' conjunct stripped as "
+             f"definitional (see logic.txt 2.3 note on nth)")
+        norm.definedness_stripped = False
     ok(f"OBL-{n}: PROVED, final step {fid} matches obligation")
 else:
     fail(f"OBL-{n}: final step {fid} does not match obligation\n"
          f"    certificate: {got}\n    obligation:  {want}")
